title: A Survey on AgentOps: Categorization, Challenges, and Future Directions

facts.fact: The paper was first posted to arXiv as version v1 on 04 August 2025, under category cs.AI.
The survey defines AgentOps (Agent System Operations) as a framework with four key stages: monitoring, anomaly detection, root cause analysis, and resolution.
facts.quote: We provide detailed definitions and explanations of its four key stages: monitoring, anomaly detection, root cause analysis, and resolution.

facts.fact: The survey categorizes anomalies in agent systems into intra-agent anomalies and inter-agent anomalies.
facts.quote: categorizing them into intra-agent anomalies and inter-agent anomalies.

facts.fact: The survey's Figure 1 illustrates an anomaly in an auction role-playing simulation in which an attack on buyer 1 results in abnormally high bids, causing the auction to collapse.
facts.quote: an attack on buyer 1 results in abnormally high bids, causing the auction to collapse.

facts.fact: The paper is listed in the ACM Computing Surveys (CSUR) journal under volume number 3741118.
